notes: The select renders 40 country options in one flat list with no search, no grouping, no type-ahead, and no default. Section 2.17 fires on excessive simultaneous choices with no guidance. The threshold in docs/checks/2.17 is roughly ten parallel options; 40 far exceeds it. Choice overload is the highest finding; it is a usability defect that blocks completion of a common task without a WCAG-level workaround, so HIGH is correct. No section 5 blocker applies.
fixture_notes: All country names are synthetic list entries invented for this fixture. No real data present.
